newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass Hut president/CEO Chadsey resigns.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass Hut president/CEO Chadsey resigns.

text.p: Speciality retailer Sunglass Hut, which last week reported a 96 percent slide in first-quarter earnings, said Friday its president and chief executive officer, Jack Chadsey, resigned to pursue other interests.
The company, which grew from 600 stores in 1993 to more than 2,000 in 1996, named Chairman James Hauslein as acting president and CEO.
It said the board of directors had formed a search committee to find a replacement for Chadsey, 49.
Sunglass Hut said last week its first-quarter net income fell to $292,000, or 1 cent a share, from $7.2 million, or 13 cents a share, a year earlier. April same-store sales fell 3.3 percent.
The company said in a statement that overall comparable-store and new-store sales were continuing "sluggish, consistent with April's trends." It will report May sales on June 5.
Sunglass Hut's stock, which traded as high as $30 in the past year, closed Thursday at $7.625 on Nasdaq.
